headline: Fishermen: Professionals in the sector launch an indefinite nationwide strike - What are their demands
summary: Professional fishermen across Greece, including coastal, trawler and gri-gri operators, began an indefinite nationwide strike on Thursday, October 1. The report outlines the sector's demands.
why: Fishing and seafood supply are small but politically sensitive parts of the Greek primary sector, and strikes can disrupt fresh fish supply and local incomes.
